scripts.test: npm run test:lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:mutation && npm run test:sast && npm run test:bench && npm run test:dast
scripts.test:sast: npm run test:sast:license && npm run test:sast:lockfile && npm run test:sast:semgrep && npm run test:sast:trufflehog && npm run test:sast:gitleaks && npm run test:sast:actionlint && npm run test:sast:zizmor && npm run test:sast:trivy
scripts.test:sast:gitleaks: npm run test:sast:gitleaks:dir && npm run test:sast:gitleaks:git
scripts.rm: npm run rm:macos && npm run rm:node_modules && npm run rm:lock
scripts.release:staged: npm whoami >/dev/null && npm query '.workspace:not([private])' | jq -r '.[].name' | xargs -n1 -I{} npm stage list {} --json | jq -r '.[] | "\(.packageName)@\(.version) \(.actor) \(.shasum)"'
scripts.release:approve: npm query '.workspace:not([private])' | jq -r '.[].name' | xargs -n1 -I{} npm stage list {} --json | jq -r --arg v "$npm_package_version" '.[] | select(.version == $v) | "\(.packageName)@\(.version) \(.id)"' | xargs -n2 -o sh -c 'echo "Approving $0"; npm stage approve "$1"'
scripts.release:sync: npm version $npm_package_version --workspaces --allow-same-version && node -e "const fs = process.getBuiltinModule('node:fs'); const v = process.env.npm_package_version; for (const d of fs.readdirSync('packages')) { const f = 'packages/' + d + '/package.json'; if (!fs.existsSync(f)) continue; const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); for (const k of ['dependencies', 'devDependencies', 'peerDependencies']) for (const n in p[k]) if (n.startsWith('@1auth/')) p[k][n] = v; fs.writeFileSync(f, JSON.stringify(p, null, '\t') + '\n'); fs.copyFileSync('LICENSE', 'packages/' + d + '/LICENSE') }" && npm install
